title: DataFrame versus RDD versus Pandas
summary: Choose the abstraction that preserves optimizer visibility and matches the workload.

blocks.text: Choose the abstraction that preserves optimizer visibility and matches the workload.

items: DataFrames expose schema and expressions to Catalyst/SQL optimization.
RDDs are lower-level and useful for specialized transformations not naturally expressed in DataFrames.
Pandas is single-machine and often simpler for moderate data.
Python UDFs can reduce optimizer visibility; prefer built-in expressions when possible.

blocks.question: Why are built-in Spark SQL functions usually preferred to Python UDFs?
blocks.answer: They preserve optimizer visibility and usually avoid extra Python serialization/execution overhead.
